definition: What a room type must hold, piece by piece, each with the floor it takes and the gap it needs around it. A room that dimensions correctly and cannot take its own furniture has failed.
basis: schema/room.schema.json, the furniture field: "What has to fit, with clearances. This is the real constraint on a room and it is almost never written down, which is why so many plans have rooms that dimension correctly and cannot be furnished."
